nota.t: Science process skills (observe, classify, measure, make inferences, predict, communicate, interpret data, control variables, hypothesize, experiment) and manipulative skills (use and operate apparatus properly, clean and store apparatus).
The adult human skeleton has 206 bones. Functions: give shape and support, protect internal organs, help joint movement of muscles.
Heart pumps blood through blood vessels throughout the body. Blood transports oxygen and food to the cells, and carries carbon dioxide to the lungs.
Exercising and eating nutritious food keeps our bones and heart healthy.

t: Pretending to be dead: cockroaches, snakes
Rubber or smell: rubber tree, Cambodia tree
Thick waxy leaves / stems store water: cactus

baris: the filling is tasty or sticky

nota.t: Sources of electricity: dry cells, batteries, power (water, coal, solar, wind).
Series circuit: one path, dimmer bulbs if added. parallel circuit: more than one path, the bulb stays lit.
Do not touch the switch with wet hands. Water is an electrical conductor.
Heat is energy. Temperature is the degree of heat, measured with a thermometer in °C.

t: Material receives heat → temperature rises, material expands.
Material loses heat → temperature drops, material shrinks.
Heat flows from hot areas to cold areas.

nota.t: A small gap is left on the railroad track so that the track does not bend when it expands on a hot day.
Objects made of iron rust when exposed to water and air.

t: Prevent rust: paint, oil/grease, zinc coating (galvanization), plastic coating, store in a dry place.
Materials that do not rust: aluminum, gold, plastic, glass, wood.

nota.t: The moon does not emit its own light. It reflects the light of the Sun. The shape of the Moon that we see changes according to its position.

t: return to the new moon (about 29.5 days)

nota.t: The Hijrah calendar is based on the movement of the Moon. Every Hijrah month starts with the new moon.
Constellations are groups of stars that form a pattern. Examples: Belantik (Orion), Frog (Ursa Major), Pari (Crux) which shows the south direction.

A complex machine is a combination of two or more simple machines. Examples: bicycle (wheel and axle, gear, lever), crane (pulley, lever), scissors (lever, wedge), can opener (wheel and axle, wedge, lever).

t: Apply lubricating oil to moving parts.
Store in a dry place to prevent rusting.
